business_rules: Idempotent: stopping an already-stopped sensor is a no-op + warn.
Exit 0 communicates that the desired post-condition is satisfied.
behavior.summary: After registry lookup with .harness/runtime/running_sensors.json present, the script finds no entry for the id and emits a warn Signal metadata.kind=not_running. Exit code is 0 because the post-condition (sensor is not running) is satisfied.

description: Idempotency invariant: /stop-sensor on a sensor id with no live registry entry emits a warn Signal explaining there is nothing to stop and exits 0 — repeated invocations after a successful stop are safe.

evidence.rationale: Early-return branch when the registry has no entry for the id.

expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has one warn Signal; exit code is 0; registry is unchanged.

name: Stopping a sensor that is not running is idempotent (warn + exit 0)

trigger.summary: Agent invokes /stop-sensor on a sensor id whose registry has no live entry.
